question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is **"no."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"No"** is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.
 
• It indicates that there are zero or none of the item being referred to.
 
• **"No"** means not any; not a. (कोई नहीं; नहीं, एक भी नहीं)
 
 
• **Example**:* I have **no**__ time to talk now.*
 
 
 
• Grammatically, it is a negative determiner that is used to negate a noun or pronoun.
 
• In this context, it suggests that the item being referred to is rare or non-existent.
 
• The correct answer is Option 2.
 
• **Correct passage**:

........"We have __**no**__ waiters here. We have only waitresses............

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1, "some,"** suggests that there is a moderate amount of the item being referred to. ((किसी वस्‍तु की) निश्चित या विशेष मात्रा या संख्‍या; कुछ राशि)
 
• **Option 3, "many,"** suggests that there is a large quantity of the item being referred to. (लोगों या वस्‍तुओं की बड़ी संख्‍या, बहुत सारे, अनेक)
 
• **Option 4, "few," **suggests that there is a small quantity of the item being referred to. (थोड़े-से, गिने-चुने; बहुत-से नहीं)
